commonality: A possibly-null value — the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()), the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo()), or a URL credential local (username / password) assigned only inside a conditional parse branch (inline user:password@ segment absent, e.g. URL body truncated at '#') — is dereferenced or passed on with no null check, so the use throws a NullPointerException; guard it with a null check, early return, ternary, or fallback default before use.
message: A possibly-null value is dereferenced or passed on without a null guard: the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()), the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo(), which return null when no matching ServiceInfo exists), or a URL credential local (username / password) that is assigned only inside a conditional parse branch and therefore stays null when the inline user:password@ segment is missing (for example the URL body was truncated at '#'). The unguarded use throws a NullPointerException. Guard the value before using it, e.g. if (x == null) return ...; / if (x != null) { ... } / x == null ? ... : x.method() / default it from a fallback source.
